jobs.description:
Our client produces excellent and consistent mushroom substrate with respect for people and nature.
Quality and flexibility are top priorities for our client.
The company is located in a traffic-free area in Roeselare.

Jobomschrijving

For our client, we are looking for a motivated INDUSTRIAL CLEANER.
	
• Assisting with emptying the tunnels (partially mechanical/partially manual)	
• Cleaning large tunnels using a high-pressure cleaner	
• Assisting with filling the tunnels	
• Thinking along when adding quantities of spawn	
• Cleaning transport belts at height (no fear of heights!)

What do we expect from you as an industrial cleaner?
	
• You have some initial experience as an industrial cleaner	
• You are in good physical health and not afraid to work in a dirty environment	
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system (5-13 & 13-21)	
• You actively contribute to the cleaning process	
• You are a team player but can also work independently	
• You speak Dutch, French or English

The Group Controller will be responsible for the finances of the holding and the consolidation for the analytic Reporting at Group Level. The role includes a quite operational maintenance of the business controlling, with an eye for details and a strong analytical mind, as well as the opportunity to discuss strategic matters and have a direct impact on the results of the company, driving the financial performance of the Group.

Jobomschrijving

The Group Controller plays a role at the center of the group activities and will manage a wide range of responsibilities. This role is transverse with a global vision and the will to have an impact. 

Group consolidation and financial reporting

• Coordinate group-wide budgets, forecasts, and long-term planning across all entities
• Contribute to financial reporting for executive management, Board, and Audit Committee
• Provide financial analysis to support management decision-making

Monitoring of holding costs

• Coordinate and monitor holding-level costs during budget and forecast cycles
• Consolidate and analyze intercompany cost data
• Ensure correct and consistent application of transfer pricing policies

Continuous improvement of financial processes and tools

• Drive improvements in financial processes, reporting, and tools
• Collaborate with controlling teams to implement best practices
• Support standardization and automation initiatives across finance

The Group Controller presents a certain set of hard and soft skills:

• Master's degree in finance, Business Management, Economics - or equivalent
• Around 4-5 years of experience in Finance (ideally in a controlling position)
• Excellent command of French & English - Dutch is a plus
• Experience with SAP
• An affinity with process management and IT tools
• Solution oriented and Proactive
• Critical mindset
• Excellent communication skills and partnering approach

The Group Controller - Consolidation will have the unique opportunity to enter a well-established, leader in its market company within a dynamic and new Financial Team. It is the opportunity to be part of a real project and to bring direct added value to the function and the Group.

Our client is the European subsidiary of a global leader in advanced alloys used in high-specification industries such as aerospace, medical, and energy.
The European headquarters hosts a truly multicultural team within a friendly, people-focused environment that combines the stability of a world-class manufacturer with the agility of a rapidly scaling organisation.
 
With ambitious growth plans across Europe and an exponentially expanding customer base, the company offers significant long-term career opportunities, internal mobility prospects, and the chance to contribute to a business positioned at the forefront of technical innovation.

Jobomschrijving

While full technical training is provided, your mission will be to ensure an excellent commercial experience for European customers and supporting the full sales cycle:

• Act as the main point of contact for customers in your assigned region, ensuring accurate verbal and written communication of all requirements.
• Manage inquiries, quotations, and orders, and coordinate with production, logistics, and technical teams across Europe and the U.S.
• Organise shipments of finished goods to European customers and follow up proactively on delivery status.
• Maintain and monitor inventory levels (general, custom, and market stock) and provide recommendations to management.
• Navigate strict quality, export compliance, and internal process requirements linked to aerospace-grade products.
• Solve day-to-day issues independently, escalating only when needed.
• Participate in weekly team meetings, one-to-ones, and ongoing coaching sessions with a dedicated local trainer.
• Contribute to continuous improvement and special internal projects.

The client is not looking for someone who has done this job before, but for a high-potential personality eager to grow, learn, and take ownership. 
Personality & Attitude :

• Ambitious, eager to accelerate their career and take on more responsibility over time (leadership, global exposure, or project ownership).
• Intellectually agile, quick to absorb large amounts of technical information.
• Exceptionally organised and structured, able to prioritise in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
• Assertive and confident on the phone, someone who proactively calls stakeholders rather than relying on emails.
• Open-minded, positive, and energetic, with strong resilience and stress resistance.
• Solution-oriented, able to anticipate issues and think ahead (plan B mindset).
• Comfortable dealing with demanding or high-level stakeholders, including U.S.-based teams.
Background & Experience :

The company welcomes talent from diverse sectors or any environment requiring:

• High customer interaction
• Complex coordination
• Strong communication & reactivity
Technical & Language Skills :

• Fluent in English (C-level) is mandatory
• At least B2 level in Turkish is required for customer interactions
• Affinity with technical topics, curiosity and willingness to learn about complex products

the client is a leading international professional services and consulting firm that supports organisations in their digital transformation journey. Working with both local and multinational clients, you will help businesses optimise their commercial, marketing and customer service processes through innovative CRM solutions.

This role offers the opportunity to work on large-scale transformation programmes, collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and contribute to projects that have a tangible impact on clients' business performance.

Jobomschrijving

As Salesforce Consultant, you will have the fllowing responsibilities:

• Partner with Belgian and international organisations to analyse business challenges across Sales, Marketing and Customer Service.
• Translate business needs into effective CRM solutions, supporting clients throughout their digital transformation journey.
• Lead or own specific workstreams while collaborating closely with functional and technical consultants to ensure successful project delivery.
• Participate in all phases of CRM implementation projects, including business analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment and post go-live support.
• Contribute to business development initiatives by supporting client proposals, presentations and commercial opportunities.
• Work within cross-functional teams in an agile project environment to deliver high-quality solutions.

• At least 3 years of experience working with Salesforce in either a functional or technical consulting role.
• Proven involvement in several CRM implementation projects from analysis through delivery.
• Good understanding of customer relationship management processes and commercial business operations.
• Ability to translate commercial objectives and business requirements into practical technical solutions.
• Familiarity with Sales, Marketing and/or Customer Service functions.
• Experience working in Agile environments is considered an advantage.
• Strong analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving skills.
• Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.
• Comfortable working in multidisciplinary and international environments.
• Fluent in English together with either Dutch or French.
• Experience with Salesforce is essential; exposure to other enterprise platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP or Oracle is considered a plus.

The company is a leading international player operating in a highly customer-centric and relationship-driven industry.
In Belgium, it works closely with an extensive network of professional partners, providing innovative solutions, commercial support and expert guidance to help them grow their business.
Backed by a strong culture of innovation and continuous improvement, the company is recognized for its commitment to customer excellence, people development and sustainable growth.

Jobomschrijving

The Account Manager - Optical Sector will have the following responsibilities :

• Drive commercial growth across Flanders by expanding the presence of ophthalmic solutions within targeted healthcare accounts.
• Identify, engage and develop new business opportunities with ophthalmologists, clinics and hospital-based eye care professionals.
• Strengthen partnerships with existing customers while building long-term relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers.
• Lead the development of strategic growth areas such as myopia management, leveraging clinical evidence and market insights.
• Promote innovative vision care solutions, including products addressing presbyopia and eye protection needs.
• Design and implement territory plans that translate market opportunities into sustainable business results.
• Act as a trusted advisor to customers by providing expertise on products, market trends, pricing and practice development opportunities.
• Coordinate cross-functional activities, including product implementation, customer training and ongoing support, to ensure a best-in-class customer experience.

• Optometrist
• Proven success in sales (MedTech / Eyecare is a must)
• Hunter profile
• Network in ophthalmology 
• Fluent in Dutch and English (French is a plus)

Line Supervisor | 2 Shifts

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

Are you an experienced operator who is ready to take the next step in your career?
Do you already have some initial experience in leadership and are you able to motivate and guide a team of employees?

Job Description:

• You are responsible for the production line assigned to you.
• Your team consists of about 9 employees (both permanent and temporary staff).
• You motivate your entire team and ensure a positive atmosphere and strong cooperation.
• You also actively take part in the production process, monitoring and controlling it.
• You stay alert and suggest improvements.
• You are able to solve small technical issues.
• During shift changes, you are responsible for the handover.

PROFIEL

• You have experience leading a team.
• You have strong social and communication skills, allowing you to communicate effectively (also with technicians and other departments).
• Working with people of different nationalities does not intimidate you.
• You can express yourself well in English. Basic knowledge of Bulgarian or Polish is a plus.
• Your formal education is less important, but you have a strong motivation to keep learning.
• You are mature, flexible, stress-resistant, and able to work independently.
• You take responsibility for your work.
• You report to the Production Manager.

AANBOD

What do you get?

• A varied and responsible position where you get the opportunity to further develop your leadership skills.
• Work in a dynamic environment, where no two days are the same and you are constantly challenged to optimize processes and lead a motivated team.
• A commuting allowance, so you can travel to and from work comfortably and cost-effectively.

STUDIEVEREISTEN
Geen specifieke studievereisten
.

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.
They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Are you looking for a meaningful job where you contribute daily to improving the lives of patients with life-threatening diseases? As a Lab Technician you will work with a passionate team to develop groundbreaking therapies and make a real difference for patients worldwide.

Your key responsibilities:
	
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.	
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.	
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.	
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.	
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.	
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste.

Who we are looking for:
	
• You have obtained a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.	
• Cell culture experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 	
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.	
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.	
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.	
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.	
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.	
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. Through this work, they make a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

They are currently in a phase of significant growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again

Join our team as a Warehouse & Operations Associate and contribute to a mission that truly makes a difference in the fight against life-threatening diseases such as bloodcancer. 

In this role, you will be part of a supportive and collaborative environment within a leading global pharmaceutical company.

As a Warehouse & Operations Associate, your responsibilities will primarily focus on operational warehouse activities with an accurate administrative follow-up. 
	
• Responsible for inbound and outbound warehouse activities in a GMP-regulated environment.	
• Receive, handle and store cryopreserved blood samples (cells) from cancer patients, which serve as the critical starting material for the manufacturing process.	
• Manage inventory, warehouse materials and internal material requests to support other departments.	
• Use SAP to process warehouse transactions and ensure accurate inventory records.	
• Maintain documentation, traceability and compliance with GMP and quality requirements.	
• Collaborate closely with other departments to support smooth day-to-day activities.

	
• You have experience in logistics, warehousing, or operational environments, or you are eager to learn and develop yourself in this field.	
• You work accurately, pay close attention to detail, and follow procedures to ensure quality, compliance, and safety.	
• You are reliable, proactive, and take ownership of your responsibilities.	
• You enjoy working in a team and collaborate effectively with colleagues across different departments.	
• You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.	
• You can commute independently to the site and are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

About the role   You will provide administrative and logistical support to our association management teams  to deliver high-quality services and value to our clients. In coordinating and communicating with our volunteer groups and committees, you will also support our associations’ mission and activities.
 

Duties and Responsibilities   

 
• bull;    Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, reports, and presentations for board, committee and working party meetings. Coordinate with all attendees. 
 
• bull;    Facilitate meetings, capturing action items and decisions. Manage post-meeting activities such as distributing minutes, tracking all action items and following up on outstanding items. 
 
• bull;    Provide administrative support, including scheduling, travel arrangements, and expense management. 
 
• bull;    Support with managing administration for corporate partnership deals and sponsorship agreements. 
 
• bull;    Track and manage the administration of grants and awards for a health care association. 
 
• bull;    Maintain governance documents, policies, and other relevant materials in a centralised repository. 
 
• bull;    Assist with the planning and execution of association events, programs, and projects. 
 
• bull;    Liaise with volunteer groups and committees and provide them with guidance, resources, and feedback. 
 
• bull;    Handle inquiries from members, partners, and the public and direct them to the appropriate person or department. 
 
• bull;    Organise and maintain files, records, and databases. 
 

Your profile   Eligible to work in the EU. At least three years’ experience in an administrative or support role, preferably in a non-profit or association setting. Fluent in English (verbal and written level C1), Knowledge of another language is an asset. Proficient in the Microsoft Office package, Google Suite, and other web-based tools. Ability to work independently and collaboratively with a diverse team. Strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritise and multitask. You are flexible, agile and committed especially in busy periods. Knowledge of and interest in the association's field and mission. Willingness to travel abroad for certain meetings and events. Available to join the team rapidly.

Our client is a leading international industrial group headquartered in Belgium. To support several members of the Executive Committee, the company is looking for a dynamic and proactive Executive Assistant in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As Executive Assistant, you will provide high-level administrative and organisational support to three C-levels, allowing them to focus on strategic priorities.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing calendars and organizing meetings.
• Coordinating business travel arrangements.
• Preparing and formatting presentations, reports and other business documents.
• Supporting leadership meetings, events and training sessions.
• Anticipating executives' needs and ensuring smooth follow-up on key actions.
• Providing ad hoc administrative support on strategic initiatives.

• You are looking for a first experience or already have a few years of experience as Management Assistant or Executive Assistant.
• You are fluent in French and English, with a good understanding of Dutch.
• You are organised, proactive and capable of managing multiple priorities.
• You are comfortable working autonomously and taking initiative.
• You communicate professionally and confidently with senior stakeholders.
• You are flexible, service-oriented and eager to learn.

This role is a HR Officer Learning & Development position focused on coordinating training, performance management, and job structuring processes while ensuring strong adoption of HR tools across the organization.
It is ideal for a dynamic and structured profile who enjoys working with people, coordinating trainings, and driving change in a digital HR environment. 

Client Details

Our client is an international company combining a corporate, international culture with a strong focus on efficiency, quality, and innovation. They support business operations through technology-driven solutions and continuous improvement of internal processes.

The environment is collaborative and evolving, offering employees the opportunity to grow and develop within the company. The company is located in Brussels and is easily accessible with public transport.

Description

As L&D HR Officer, you'll be responsible for:

• Coordinate, organize, and deliver training sessions
• Maintain & update the training catalogue
• Identify development needs and manage relationships with external training providers
• Ensure accurate HR data management and documentation (training records, performance data, job files)
• Coordinate and manage the performance management cycle (ensuring timely completion of objectives setting and reviews)
• Act as key user of HR tools providing user support and driving adoption across the organization
• Maintain and update job descriptions, job grading, and organizational charts
• Support career development initiatives
• Contribute and support HR activities when needed

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in HR, training, education, or a related field
• Fluent in English, with a good command of French or Dutch
• First experience in HR, HR Development, Learning & Development, or a similar role (junior profiles welcome)
• Dynamic, proactive, and able to convince stakeholders to adopt new tools and processes
• Strong organizational skills with a structured and detail-oriented mindset
• Curious and hands-on, with a willingness to learn and take ownership of HR systems and tools
• Strong communication skills with the ability to interact at all levels of the organization

jobs.occupation: Kitchen Help Industrial Kitchen - Aalter - 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or a perfectly cooked roast beef: you’ll be licking your fingers and thumbs. And in this role, you’ll make sure others can do the same. In our kitchen, we create dishes that would make grandmothers jealous—but on an industrial scale, in large quantities.
 

We’re looking for a Kitchen Help for a food company in Aalter!
 

Hygiene is crucial for a kitchen staff member. That’s why you’ll ensure every day that your work methods and the final products meet all standards.
 

You’ll also follow safety regulations to the letter. You’ll do everything in your power to guarantee both quality and safety. 
 

 

Who are you?

• You have experience as a cook in a commercial or industrial kitchen. Do you also have experience in a production environment? If so, that’s a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system.
• The early shift starts at 4:30 a.m. and runs until 12:30 p.m.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 p.m. and runs until 8:00 p.m.
• You know how to operate machinery or are willing to undergo training for this.
• Physical work doesn’t deter you, and you’re hands-on.
• You work with great precision and are flexible and able to handle stress.
• You’re a good communicator, enjoy variety, and like working in a team.
• You speak Dutch or English well.

The client is a recruitment group recognized as the leader in specialized recruitment in Belgium and internationally, with a presence in 36 countries and 141 offices worldwide.

Jobomschrijving

Recruitment Consultant 180 Model - Candidate side - Brussels

• Identify and attract qualified freelance professionals through sourcing strategies
• Conduct in-depth interviews to assess expertise
• Evaluate and match candidates with client requirements
• Build long-term relationships with freelance professionals
• Engage with passive candidates and develop a strong talent pipeline
• Provide candidates with guidance and market insights
• Partner closely with the sales team to understand client needs and deliver relevant talent solutions.
• Maintain accurate candidate information within the ATS.

Recruitment Consultant 180 Model - Candidate side - Brussels

• At least 3 years experiences in recruitment
• Strong interviewing, assessment, and talent evaluation skills.
• Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.
• Proven experience in sourcing, headhunting, or recruitment.
• Ability to understand professional backgrounds and identify transferable skills.
• Proactive, resilient, and results-oriented mindset.
• Ability to build and maintain long-term professional communities.
• Fluent in English and French or Dutch

As HR Assistant you will ensure administrative and organizational support to the HR key processes staffing, onboarding and training, you will produce recurrent HR data reports, keep databases up to date, process contracts and invoices and provide administrative ad hoc support.?You will report to the HR Director.

Are you inspired by these responsibilities?
Training administration & practical organization: planning of meetings, planning of trainings, coordination of subscriptions and changes, reservation of meeting rooms/lunches, sending and following up reminders and evaluation documents, create and file participant lists
Recruitment administration: interview planning, letters to candidates, maintenance of filing and databases
Administrative coordination of the onboarding process of newcomers ? Creation of HR data reports using the payroll system
Keeping HR intranet up to date, for ensuring correct information to staff ? Processing procedures for contracts, expenses and invoices
Ad hoc support: organization and meeting minutes of working groups, translation of documents (Dutch into English and vice versa, French into Dutch), budget follow up, ensuring office supplies,...
Our ideal candidate has the following competencies:
Bachelor degree in office management or related field
5 to 10 years of experience in similar roles (recruitment support included)
Excellent level of English and Dutch (spoken and written communication); excellent understanding of French
Advanced level of MS Office tools, in particular Excel and PowerPoint, and basic project management skills
Being accurate, reliable, discrete and passionate for delivering top-class service
Client friendly communication and strong organizational skills
Flexible team player, with proactive ownership for the own responsibilities and willing to constantly improve

Our client is a leading international law firm with a strong reputation for excellence and a collaborative working environment. To support its Brussels office, the firm is looking for a highly organised and proactive Legal Secretary.

Jobomschrijving

As a Legal Secretary, you will provide comprehensive administrative support to a team of lawyers and contribute to the smooth running of the office. Your responsibilities will include:

• Agenda management, organisation of meetings en events.
• Coordinating travel arrangements.
• Handling calls, emails and correspondence.
• Preparing, formatting and proofreading legal documents, presentations, reports and correspondence.
• Supporting billing processes and expense reporting.
• Working closely with colleagues across the Brussels and international offices to ensure seamless support.

• You have at least 2 years of experience in an administrative, Legal Assistant, Management Assistant or Executive Assistant role.
• Experience within a legal or professional services environment is an asset.
• You are fluent in English, French is a plus
• You have excellent organisational skills and strong attention to detail.
• You can manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high level of accuracy and professionalism.
• You are proactive, adaptable and able to work both independently and as part of a team.

Searching for a job in Sales? Eager to learn everything from the bottom to the top?
Want to work in a company who's values are doing the right thing, doing waht is best for the customer and driven in improvements and innovations?

This internationaly active production company is looking for a highly self-motivated, results oriented and solutions driven Management Trainee with a general interest in all levels of a business and a general interest in developing new technologies. After completing the management trainee program, you will be assigned to a full-time position in Sales.

The client's management trainee program is designed for recent university graduates who are highly motivated and have the potential to excel as future global leaders at the company. The training program is customized to meet the skills of the employee along with the needs of the company.

It offers challenging work assignments along with hands on training in manufacturing, quality control, administration, sales & marketing, and logistics. You will be exposed to all areas of the business and learn by successfully completing various projects in the different departments.

• A master or bachelor degree.
• If you have already strong sales skills for new account development that would be an advantage.
• 2 years of previous work experiences.
• A fluent pen and verbal skills in English and Dutch. Any additional languages would be great.
• Able to work autonomously, in a structured and efficient way.
• Strong sense of urgency, listening, communication and organizational skills.

Robert Half is currently looking for a Cost Accounting & Reporting Specialist (m/f/x) for a permanent position.

Our client is an international company located in Groot-Bijgaarden.

As a Cost Accounting, your responsibilities will include:

• Monitoring and analysing operational expenses and ensuring accurate cost tracking.
• Processing and reviewing invoices while maintaining accurate accounting records.
• Supporting month-end and year-end closing activities, including reconciliations and journal entries.
• Assisting with budgeting, forecasting and financial analysis.
• Preparing financial reports and supporting internal and external audits.
• Contributing to process improvements and ensuring compliance with internal procedures.
 

The required qualifications for this position of Cost Accounting & Reporting Specialist are:

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent through experience.
• You have at least 5 years of accounting experience.
• Experience within the Services or Retail sector is required.
• You are fluent in English. Knowledge of French, German or other European languages is considered an asset.
• You have advanced Excel skills and experience working with SAP. Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA is a plus.
• Experience in an international or shared service environment and knowledge of IFRS are considered strong assets.

Would you like to play a key role in the further development of laser cutting activities while working on a wide variety of projects?

Then you might be the talent we're looking for!

We are looking for a skilled and motivated Laser Operator who is ready for a new challenge.

What does your working day look like?

 
• Reading and interpreting technical drawings
 
• Loading machines with the correct materials
 
• Setting machine parameters
 
• Performing quality checks, both on the finished products and the operation of the machines
 
• Preparing jobs and coordinating with colleagues
 
• Determining the correct sequence of operations and creating an efficient work schedule
 
• Programming, setting up and preparing CNC-controlled machine tools for production
 
• Accurately measuring and inspecting machined components
 
• Maintaining and cleaning machines and equipment

 
• You have completed training in metalworking or have relevant professional experience
 
• Experience with laser cutting machines is a must
 
• Reading and interpreting technical drawings comes naturally to you
 
• You speak English. Knowledge of French is a plus
